title: Personal Sender Account Standing Relief on Mobile Wallet Resend Charges
content:
**Mobile Wallet** resend charges carry a relief for long-standing customers at higher Personal Sender Account levels.

**Relief rule.** The account-standing relief on a resend charge follows the customer's Personal Sender Account, its level and how long it has been open, counted in whole calendar months from the account's opened date to today:

| Personal Sender Account level | Open at least 24 whole calendar months | Relief on the resend charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Enhanced or higher (level number 4 or more) | yes | 1.00 of the charge (the whole charge) |
| Paloma Verified Plus (level number 3) | yes | 0.50 of the charge |
| Paloma Enhanced or higher | no | no relief |
| Paloma Verified Plus | no | no relief |
| any lower level | either | no relief |

A relief is a share taken off the charge: a relief of 0.50 leaves one less 0.50 of it, that is half; a relief of 1.00 leaves nothing.

## Boundary on tenure (hypothetical dates)
- Account opened 2024-03-15, today 2026-03-15: 24 whole calendar months, so the tenure condition is met.
- Account opened 2024-03-15, today 2026-03-14: 23 whole calendar months, so it is not met and no relief applies, whatever the level.

## Hypothetical cases
- Paloma Verified Plus account open 30 months, charge figure 2.00: relief 0.50, leaving 1.00.
- Paloma Enhanced account open 25 months: relief 1.00, leaving nothing of the charge.
- Paloma Verified account open 60 months: no relief.
